events.what: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said it struck four ships doing a ship-to-ship transfer, leaving them on fire; three other ships struck mines Oct. 21
IMO recorded 29 attacks during Oct. 1-22, exceeding all monthly tallies since March
Houthis claimed four strikes inside Saudi Arabia including a direct hit on Aramco facilities at Yanbu; Aramco did not respond; US State Dept ordered departure of non-emergency staff in Saudi Arabia
Trump said Washington is not negotiating with Iran and that 'something one way or another' would happen 'fairly soon'
Individuals closed isolation valve on pipeline to Zawiya refinery, curtailing Hamada and Tahara output; eastern House accepted Central Bank governor resignation
US Treasury renewed Lukoil sanctions waiver until Nov. 21 (eleventh extension); Carlyle no longer pursuing Lukoil international assets
US and Russia agreed deal for Russian diesel supplies; Dmitriev said Oct. 22 more energy deals to come
IEA Governing Board said members will accelerate emergency oil stock releases
Spain to release 4.4 million barrels of diesel and jet reserves until Dec. 15
Rough seas closed 75 Pacific ports including Petroperu terminals; closures expected until Oct. 25
Crescent Energy bought Devon's Eagle Ford assets for $3.85 billion
Typhoon Champi expected to peak around Oct. 25, threatening Zhoushan operations

themes.theme: Hormuz attacks and Gulf export recovery
themes.summary: Iran struck ships off Oman, IMO logged 29 attacks Oct. 1-22 and war risk premiums rose, yet Middle East exports recovered to 19.2 million b/d on Oct. 18 and Brent settled $113.17/b.

themes.theme: Houthi strikes on Saudi and Red Sea rerouting
themes.summary: Houthis claimed a direct hit on Aramco Yanbu facilities, Bab al-Mandab transits fell to 34, while Saudi crude shifted to Suez and SUMED at three-year-high tanker transits.

themes.theme: Freight spike and wide crude differentials
themes.summary: VLCC USGC-Asia freight of $30-$35/b widens USGC and Canadian crude discounts (Canadian $27-$30 under Brent) while physical sour grades in Europe are in glut.
Trump said no talks with Iran, while US-Russia energy deals, a Lukoil waiver extension to Nov. 21 and Ukrainian attacks on Russian infrastructure keep Russian flows uncertain.

themes.theme: US shale output, rigs and M&A
themes.summary: Wood Mackenzie sees 11.33 million b/d in 2026, Permian rigs fell 6 to 239, and high prices are re-rating assets with output growth expected in 2027.
A valve shutdown curtailed Hamada and Tahara output for the second time in weeks, following the September shutdown, amid a Central Bank governor row.

themes.theme: Emergency stock releases and diesel tightness
themes.summary: IEA accelerated releases, Spain cut middle distillate reserves to 82 days and ULSD CIF NWE stood at $1,470.5/mt Oct. 21, while Italian diesel sales fell almost 8% YOY.
